# engine

`bind_bridge`, `key_dispatcher`, `view_driver`, `dvars`, and `install` form the IW4 gamepad engine boundary, translating controller samples into engine bindings, key events, movement, view angles, dvars, console commands, and hook callbacks.

## Contents

- [bind.cpp](./bind.cpp) — `bind_bridge` queues named controller layouts, applies `mapping::binding_table`, migrates legacy commands, and tracks `"custom"` manual layouts.
- [bind.hpp](./bind.hpp) — `bind_bridge` and `controller_command_for` define layout application, binding lookup, and controller-command migration contracts.
- [command.cpp](./command.cpp) — `register_commands` registers `controller_status`, `bindgpbuttonsconfigs`, and `bindgpsticksconfigs`.
- [command.hpp](./command.hpp) — `register_commands` declares fixed-order console-command registration through `runtime`.
- [dvar.cpp](./dvar.cpp) — `register_dvars` registers controller configuration dvars, while `publish_present` updates `gpad_present`.
- [dvar.hpp](./dvar.hpp) — `dvars`, `register_dvars`, `publish_present`, and typed `read` overloads define the engine dvar registry.
- [hook.cpp](./hook.cpp) — `install`, `controller_key_name`, `controller_key_from_name`, and `mouse_move_body` install key conversion and mouse-move detours.
- [hook.hpp](./hook.hpp) — `install(runtime&)` declares engine hook installation.
- [import.cpp](./import.cpp) — `Dvar_Register*`, `Dvar_Set*`, `emit_key`, `aim_globals`, `view_pitch`, `view_yaw`, and `frame_seconds` adapt engine calls and memory-backed state.
- [import.hpp](./import.hpp) — `dvar_t`, `usercmd_s`, dvar flags, key constants, `AimScreenTarget`, and `AimAssistGlobals` define the imported engine ABI.
- [key.cpp](./key.cpp) — `key_dispatcher` translates `canonical_sample` buttons and axes into engine events, menu input, fallback commands, and controller ownership.
- [key.hpp](./key.hpp) — `key_dispatcher` declares sample dispatch, repeat handling, ownership state, and `release_all`.
- [netmove.cpp](./netmove.cpp) — `move_changed`, `pack_move`, and `unpack_move` implement XOR-packed movement deltas.
- [netmove.hpp](./netmove.hpp) — `move_delta` and the movement codec define the pure network movement API.
- [view.cpp](./view.cpp) — `view_driver` shapes movement, rebuilds aim calibration, applies slowdown and lock-on, and mutates `usercmd_s`.
- [view.hpp](./view.hpp) — `view_driver` declares sampling, idle state, local movement, and remote movement integration.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`canonical_sample` enters `key_dispatcher::dispatch` and `view_driver::observe`; `key_dispatcher` emits `emit_key` transitions or `game::Cbuf_AddText` fallback commands, while `view_driver::apply_move` mutates `usercmd_s` after native mouse processing.

`register_dvars` creates `dvars`; `key_dispatcher`, `bind_bridge`, and `view_driver` consume those handles through `read`, `publish_present`, and engine registration helpers.

`install` connects `controller_key_name`, `controller_key_from_name`, `mouse_move_body`, `runtime::view`, and `patches::enforce_ads_sprint_interrupt` to engine callsites.

## Patterns

`dvars` uses a typed-handle registry with null-safe `read` overloads and change-filtered `publish_present`.

`key_dispatcher` uses edge detection through `buttons_`, axis hysteresis through `deflected_` and `was_deflected_`, and lifecycle cleanup through `release_all`.

`view_driver` uses `tuning_signature_`, `have_signature_`, `calibration_`, and `processor_` to cache aim processing and rebuild state only after dvar changes.

`bind_bridge` treats the engine bind table as authoritative and isolates engine keynum lookup inside `command_keys`.

## API Surface

`register_commands(const context&, runtime&)`, `register_dvars(const context&)`, `install(runtime&)`, `move_changed`, `pack_move`, `unpack_move`, `controller_command_for`, and the `bind_bridge`, `key_dispatcher`, and `view_driver` classes define the directory API.

`AimAssistGlobals` uses `#pragma pack(1)` with `screenTargets == 0xFC`, `screenTargetCount == 0xDFC`, and `sizeof == 0xE34`.

## Behavioral Contracts

`controller_command_for` maps `+activate` and `+reload` to `+usereload`, and `+melee_breath` to `+holdbreath`.

`custom_layout` equals `"custom"`; `apply_configured_layout` skips `"custom"`, while `note_manual_rebind` writes `"custom"` through `Dvar_SetString`.

`command_keys` initializes both output keys to `-1`, returns at most two matches, and restricts lookup to the active half of the 256-key space.

`queue_fallback` formats held commands as `"%s %d %u\n"`, released plus-commands as `"-%s %d %u\n"`, and one-shot commands as `"%s\n"`.

`pack_move` stores `forward` in the low byte and `right` in the high byte, XORs with `key`, and masks `0xFFFF`; `unpack_move` reverses the operation using `int8_t`.

`key_dispatcher` uses `scroll_delay_first == 420`, `scroll_delay_rest == 210`, `scroll_delay_min == 50`, `scroll_accel_time == 1500`, and `controller_use_hold_time == 250`.

`view_driver` clamps movement to `[-128, 127]`, frame time to `[0.0f, 0.05f]`, pitch to `[-85.0f, 85.0f]`, and target counts to `[0, 64]`.

`best_target` uses `8192.0f * max(range_scale, 0.0f)` as the aim-assist range bound and requires finite positive `distSqr`.

`frame_seconds` clamps `0x11255D70` milliseconds to `[0, 200]` before multiplying by `0.001f`.

## File Relationships

`bind.cpp` consumes `mapping::binding_table` and `apply_button_layout`; `key.cpp` consumes `mapping::engine_key`, `mapping::to_engine_key`, `mapping::axis_deflected`, and `mapping::all_engine_keys`.

`view.cpp` consumes `aim::validate`, `aim::apply`, `mapping::stick_layout_from_name`, `mapping::resolve`, `slowdown_scale`, and `lock_on`.

`import.cpp` exposes `game::game_offset(0x1149D290)`, `game::game_offset(0x11A9FEC0)`, and `game::game_offset(0x11A9FEC4)` for aim globals, pitch, and yaw.

`hook.cpp` patches `game::game_offset(0x102FFBFE)` and invokes native `CL_MouseMove` at `game::game_offset(0x102FC4D0)`.

`release_all` is the lifecycle boundary that clears `buttons_`, `deflected_`, `was_deflected_`, and scroll ownership after controller removal.
